data.body_html:
Planning an Estepona boat rental no license 2027? Whether you want to cruise the Costa del Sol coastline, anchor at a quiet cove, or just enjoy the views of La Concha from the water, you don't need a boating license. Every boat in our fleet comes with a qualified skipper included in the price. That means you can relax, swim, and sunbathe while an expert handles the navigation. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours, and all charters depart from Puerto Banús – just 15 minutes from Estepona.

Why Choose a Skippered Boat Rental in Estepona?

Skippered charters are the easiest way to enjoy the Mediterranean without paperwork or training. There’s no exam, no permit, and no stress. Your skipper knows the local waters, the best anchorages, and the weather patterns. They’ll also handle mooring, fuel, and safety checks. For groups, families, or celebrations, it’s the simplest way to get on the water.

No License Boats Available for 2027

Our fleet includes a range of vessels for different group sizes and budgets. All come with a skipper, so you can book with confidence. Here are the most popular options:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – from €749/2h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – from €749/2h
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h (includes free jet ski)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – pricing on request

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are great choices. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, a short drive from Estepona.

What’s Included in Your Charter?

No hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

Just bring sunscreen, towels, and your swimwear.

Where Will You Cruise From Estepona?

Your skipper will suggest a route based on the weather and your preferences. Popular destinations from Puerto Banús include:

  • Cala del Faro – a quiet cove with crystal water, ideal for swimming
  • Cala Cortés – sheltered bay near Cabopino
  • Marbella coastline – views of the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain
  • Estepona old town – see the marina from the water
  • Sotogrande – a longer cruise south for lunch

Most charters include time to anchor, swim, and enjoy the onboard drinks and snacks.

How to Book Your No License Boat Rental for 2027

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can see fixed prices above. For all other boats, send a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We’ll confirm availability and send a quote. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance for summer 2027.

Check out our full fleet on the Boat Rental Marbella homepage for more options.
